text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Dants... do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeees? Ah, if it's about tomorrow's 
homework—huh?

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even though I said such awful things... 
*sniff*. I was just so scared, I couldn't 
bring myself to talk to them... *sob*.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I see... That must've been rough. Yeah, I 
totally get why it was scary, too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"You can't help but keep wondering what 
the right move was, huh? Yeah... it's 
tough."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(......Ah, it's almost time for 
training... I have to go...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm sorry, Trainer. Right now, I just 
want to stay by your side...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame got so caught up in listening 
to her friend's problems that she ended up 
skipping training...
